description: Frontend: four new Super Admin pages (/admin/models, /admin/providers/tts, /admin/providers/stt, /admin/providers/llm), AdminSidebar additions, and api.ts extensions. Uses existing light theme, shared UI primitives, and the auth pattern from admin/providers/page.tsx. Depends on FEAT-001 (backend endpoints must exist). Independent of FEAT-002 (tests).
steps: 1. Add TypeScript interfaces to frontend/lib/api.ts: AIModelCatalogue {id, provider_name, model_id, capability, hosting_mode, supported_languages, streaming_supported, credential_requirements, setup_requirements, license_spdx, commercial_use_allowed, free_tier_info, free_tier_verified_date, pricing_per_minute_usd, doc_url, model_card_url, implementation_status, notes}. ProviderConfiguration {id, capability, provider_name, model_id, is_active, is_fallback, voice, language, extra_params, last_tested_at, last_test_result, last_test_latency_ms, activated_at, created_at}. ProviderCredentialMeta {provider_name, key_hint, created_at, rotated_at}. ConnectProviderRequest {provider_name, model_id, capability, credential_plaintext?, voice?, language?, extra_params?, is_fallback?}. TestResult {status, latency_ms, error?, sample_output_b64?, transcript?, response?}.

2. Add api.modelDirectory namespace to the api object in frontend/lib/api.ts: catalogue(params?: {capability?, status?, search?}) => GET /api/v1/model-directory/catalogue with query string. getModel(modelId) => GET /api/v1/model-directory/catalogue/{modelId}. listConfigs(capability?) => GET /api/v1/model-directory/configurations. getConfig(configId) => GET /api/v1/model-directory/configurations/{configId}. connect(body: ConnectProviderRequest) => POST /api/v1/model-directory/configurations. testConfig(configId) => POST /api/v1/model-directory/configurations/{configId}/test. activateConfig(configId) => POST /api/v1/model-directory/configurations/{configId}/activate. setFallback(configId, fallbackConfigId) => POST /api/v1/model-directory/configurations/{configId}/fallback with body {fallback_config_id}. deleteConfig(configId) => DELETE /api/v1/model-directory/configurations/{configId}. listCredentials(providerName) => GET /api/v1/model-directory/credentials/{providerName}. rotateCredential(providerName, newPlaintext) => POST /api/v1/model-directory/credentials/{providerName}/rotate. deleteCredential(providerName) => DELETE /api/v1/model-directory/credentials/{providerName}.

3. Update frontend/components/layout/admin-sidebar.tsx: add four new entries to ADMIN_LINKS array (after the existing 'Providers' link): {href: '/admin/models', label: 'AI Models', icon: BrainCircuit}, {href: '/admin/providers/tts', label: 'TTS Config', icon: Volume2}, {href: '/admin/providers/stt', label: 'STT Config', icon: AudioWaveform}, {href: '/admin/providers/llm', label: 'LLM Config', icon: Bot}. Import BrainCircuit, Volume2, AudioWaveform, Bot from lucide-react. The existing active-path detection logic (pathname.startsWith(href)) handles sub-paths correctly.

4. Create frontend/app/(admin)/admin/models/page.tsx — /admin/models (AI Models Directory). 'use client'. State: models (AIModelCatalogue[]), loading, search (string), capabilityFilter ('all'|'tts'|'stt'|'llm'), statusFilter. Load via api.modelDirectory.catalogue() on mount; re-fetch when filters change using useCallback debounced 300ms. UI: search input (text, placeholder 'Search models...'), capability tab strip (All/LLM/TTS/STT using Button variant secondary/primary), status filter dropdown (All/Supported/Experimental/Unavailable). Grid of model cards (CSS grid 1-2-3 cols at sm/md/lg). Each ModelCard shows: provider_name + model_id as title, capability badge (color-coded: llm=accent, tts=blue, stt=green), hosting_mode badge, implementation_status badge (supported=success, experimental=warning, unavailable=danger), supported_languages (comma list, truncate at 5 with +N more), streaming_supported icon, free_tier_info summary (if present and free_tier_verified_date not older than 90 days, else show 'Pricing data may be stale'), commercial_use_allowed icon. Action button: if implementation_status=='supported' and hosting_mode=='managed_api': primary 'Connect' button → navigates to /admin/providers/{capability} with ?model={model_id}&provider={provider_name} query params. If implementation_status=='supported' and hosting_mode=='local_runtime': 'Configure Local' button → same nav. If implementation_status=='experimental': disabled 'Experimental' button with tooltip. If implementation_status=='unavailable': disabled 'Unavailable'. Never show a 'Connected' state on this page — that lives on the provider config pages.

5. Create shared component frontend/components/model-directory/ProviderConfigPanel.tsx — used by all three provider config pages. Props: capability ('tts'|'stt'|'llm'). 'use client'. Internal state: configs (ProviderConfiguration[]), credentials (Record<string, ProviderCredentialMeta[]>), catalogue (AIModelCatalogue[]), loading, configuring (boolean), testing (Record<string, boolean>), activating (Record<string, boolean>), showConnectModal (boolean), selectedModel (AIModelCatalogue|null), connectForm ({credential_plaintext, voice, language, extra_params}), connectError (string|null). Layout: two sections. Top: 'Active Configuration' card — shows current active config (provider + model + voice + language + last_test_result + last_test_latency_ms + activated_at) or EmptyState 'No active provider'. Fallback config sub-section. Bottom: 'Available Configurations' table with columns: Provider, Model, Status (configured/tested/active), Last Tested, Actions. Actions per row: Test button (calls api.modelDirectory.testConfig, updates row with result inline — green checkmark+latency or red X+error), Activate button (disabled if not tested or test_result!='ok'; calls activateConfig, confirms with dialog), Delete button. Plus button '+' → opens ConnectModal. ConnectModal: select model from catalogue filtered by capability (dropdown showing provider_name+model_id+implementation_status); if credential_requirements is non-empty, show password input for API key (type='password', autocomplete='new-password'); voice selector (only for TTS, shows hardcoded list per provider); language selector from model.supported_languages; Submit calls api.modelDirectory.connect(); errors shown inline in modal; on success close modal and reload configs. Credential section (collapsible): per-provider shows key_hint, created_at, Rotate button (opens inline form with password input), Delete button with confirmation.

6. Create frontend/app/(admin)/admin/providers/tts/page.tsx — 'use client'. Imports ProviderConfigPanel. Renders: page header 'TTS Provider Configuration', sub-text 'Configure the text-to-speech provider for the call pipeline.', then <ProviderConfigPanel capability='tts' />.
7. Create frontend/app/(admin)/admin/providers/stt/page.tsx — same pattern as TTS page with capability='stt' and header 'STT Provider Configuration'.

8. Create frontend/app/(admin)/admin/providers/llm/page.tsx — same pattern with capability='llm' and header 'LLM Provider Configuration'. For LLM, ProviderConfigPanel should add an extra_params JSON editor field in ConnectModal (textarea with JSON validation) for model parameters like temperature, max_tokens.

9. Verify the existing /admin/providers page (frontend/app/(admin)/admin/providers/page.tsx) is unchanged — it should still work as before. The new sub-pages are /admin/providers/tts, /admin/providers/stt, /admin/providers/llm which Next.js App Router treats as separate leaf routes under the same directory; the existing page.tsx at /admin/providers/ is not affected.

10. Run frontend build to catch TypeScript errors: cd frontend && npm run build. Fix any type errors before committing. Common issues to anticipate: ensure all api.modelDirectory methods are typed with correct return types, ensure ProviderConfigPanel props interface is exported, ensure lucide-react icons are available (BrainCircuit was added in lucide-react v0.400+; check frontend/package.json version and use alternatives if needed — Cpu, Brain, or CircuitBoard are safe fallbacks).
acceptance_criteria: cd frontend && npm run build completes with 0 TypeScript errors and 0 ESLint errors
/admin/models page renders with search, capability filter tabs, and model cards grid
AdminSidebar shows AI Models, TTS Config, STT Config, LLM Config links with correct active state
ProviderConfigPanel shows active config card, configurations table, and Connect modal per capability
Connect modal has masked credential input (type=password) and never shows plaintext in the DOM
Test button calls testConfig API and shows inline result (latency or error) without page reload
Activate button disabled until test result is 'ok'; calls activateConfig on click
Free-tier staleness warning shown when free_tier_verified_date > 90 days ago
Existing /admin/providers page unchanged and still works
